channels.title: Message channels
channels.description: Choose which channels may carry appointment messages to your contacts: confirmations, reminders, reschedule and cancellation notices, and after-visit follow-ups. A booking type can use a channel only when it is switched on here and connected.
channels.undecidedOwner: No channel is switched on yet, so no appointment message is sent. Switch on the channels your team may use.
channels.undecidedMember: No channel is switched on yet, so no appointment message is sent. Ask the workspace owner to choose the channels.
channels.readOnly: Only the workspace owner and admins can change these.
channels.notConnected: Nothing is connected for this channel yet.
channels.voiceSoon: Coming with the Voice bot: an outbound reminder call you will be able to switch on for each booking type. It cannot be switched on yet.

about.email: From a shared mailbox of your workspace. Never from a personal mailbox.
about.whatsapp: Free text inside the 24 hour window; outside it only an approved template.
about.sms: Plain text from your connected SMS sender.
about.voice: An automatic outbound call that reminds the contact.

channels.editorHint: Only channels the workspace owner switched on and that are connected can be used. The rest are shown so you know why.
channels.noneUsable: No channel is available yet, so no message of this booking type can be sent.
channels.offByOwner: The workspace owner has not switched this channel on.
channels.sendOnAuto: No channel chosen: the first available channel is used, with the standard text.
channels.sendOnEach: The message goes out on every channel ticked here.
channels.attachedButUnusable: This channel is not available now, so this message is skipped on it. Untick it or ask the owner to switch it on.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.description: Predefined messages for confirmations, reminders, reschedules, cancellations and after-visit follow-ups. Add one with a click and edit it. Email messages live here; WhatsApp messages are sent to Meta for approval and only an approved one can be used.
templates.readOnly: Only users who manage appointment templates can change these.
templates.empty: No message added yet. Add one from the predefined set below.
templates.usedBy: {count, plural, one {used by # booking type} other {used by # booking types}}
templates.submitted: Sent to Meta. It is in review now.
templates.metaRefused: Saved, but Meta refused it. Open the message to see the reason.
templates.deleteWhatsapp: It is removed from this list. The WhatsApp template stays in your WhatsApp templates; delete it there if you no longer need it.
templates.deleteBody: It is removed from your library. A booking type that uses it must choose another message first.
templates.pendingNote: Meta is reviewing this template. Until it is approved it cannot be chosen or sent.
templates.textLocked: A template that is in review or approved cannot be edited here.
templates.whatsappPlaceholders: WhatsApp can fill only these, used in this order without skipping one:
templates.predefinedHint: Adopt a message to copy it into your library, then edit it. A WhatsApp message is created as a draft first; you decide when to send it to Meta.
templates.machineNote: The predefined texts are written in English. Edit them to your language after adding them.
templates.unknownMessage: A message that is no longer available
templates.noneYet: No message of this kind yet.
templates.whatsappApprovedOnly: Only templates Meta has approved can be chosen. Outside the 24 hour window WhatsApp sends nothing else.

reminders.voiceSoon: Coming with the Voice bot: an outbound reminder call. It cannot be added yet.
reminders.noUsableChannel: None of this rule's channels is available, so it cannot be switched on.
reminders.fromLibrary: Use a message from the library

reasons.channel_disabled: The workspace has switched this channel off for appointment messages.

problems.templateNoChannel: Choose at least one channel for this message, or clear its text.
